machine_start_gcode.default_value:
T0
M190 S{material_bed_temperature}
M104 S{material_print_temperature}
M109 S{material_print_temperature}
M98 P"startPrint.g" 
M83 ;absolute extrusion mode
G21 ;metric values
G90 ;absolute positioning
M83 ;set extruder to absolute mode
M107 ;start with the fan off
G28; Home Axis
G29 S1; Z-Probe the bed (requires Z-Probe!)
G1 Z5.0 F9000 ;move the head 5mm up for CYA clearance
G92 E0 ;zero the extruded length
M117 Cleaning...;Put Cleaning message on screen
G1 X-20 Y0 F4000 ; move half way along the front edge
G1 Z1 ; move nozzle close to bed
M109 S{material_print_temperature} ; heat nozzle to 200 degC and wait until reached
G4 P5000 ; wait 10 seconds for nozzle length to stabilize
G1 E10 F200; extrude 10 mm of filament
G1 Z15 F12000 E5 ; move 15 mm up, fast, while extruding 5mm
G92 E0 ; reset extruder
M117 Printing...;Put printing message on LCD screen

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
G1 X5 Y5 F3000 ;Wipe out
G90 ;Absolute positionning
G1 X0 Y0 ;Present print
M106 S0 ;Turn-off fan
M104 T0 S0 ;Turn-off hotend
M104 T1 S0 ;Turn-off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn-off bed
M84 X Y E ;Disable all steppers but Z
M98 P"endPrint.g"
